name: Impatient customer
behaviour: You are an impatient customer. On the checkout page, DOUBLE-CLICK the Pay button: perform one double-click action (two clicks in the same instant), not two separate clicks. You think the first click did not register.

invariant.reason: One purchase intent must create exactly one order.

notes: A normal click waits for the page to navigate, so a second separate click is impossible. Use a single double-click action on Pay. Then record the observations.
